note: Adapted from Hill's (1942) English species-level description; the original describes the alate and the soldier, the worker being listed only as a morphotype and not described. OCR problems: the postclypeus measurement reads '0.29 x 0.5l', the last digit being read as 1; 'thau' is than and 'sth' is 5th; 'Pigs.' is an error for Figs.; the 3 in '3, obeuntis' is a misreading of H. Type locality Northern Territory: Marrakai, consistent with the checklist. Distribution and biology are not translated into the morphology sections.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Most closely related to A. obeuntis. Compared with A. pavidus, the alate is smaller, darker and differently shaped as regards the fontanelle, with antennae 15-segmented instead of 14; the soldier has smaller mandibles of a different shape, and antennae with 1 segment more than in that species.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: A small pale brown species; postclypeus clay-coloured; compound eyes large and protruding; ocelli large. Fontanelle large, with a small elongate-oval prolongation. Postclypeus less than twice as long as wide (0.29 × 0.51). Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 shortest; segments 4 and 5 subequal, or segment 4 slightly longer than segment 5. Mandibular tooth 2 distinctly smaller than the apical tooth and very far from it. Anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum slightly concave. Posterior margin of mesonotum and metanotum wide and rather deeply emarginate. Radius absent in both wings. Measurements: length with wings 10.00 mm, length without wings 5.00 mm, head length (to apex of labrum) 1.06—1.17 mm, head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 0.55—0.62 mm, head width 1.00—1.07 mm, maximum diameter of compound eye 0.33 mm, ocellus length 0.12—0.13 mm, pronotum length 0.47—0.51 mm, width 0.80—0.91 mm, forewing length 8.25 mm, width 2.40 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: A small species; head pale yellow-brown; basal half of the mandibles pale rusty, apical half dark rusty. Head short, wide and deep, the sides nearly parallel or moderately rounded. Mandibles short and stout, distinctly curved, wide at the base, with a short, rather blunt, backwardly directed tooth near the middle. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 3 longer than segment 4; segment 5 longer than segment 3, in a few cases segments 4 and 5 subequal. Measurements: total length 4.50 mm, head length (mandibles crossing at the tooth, including mandibles) 1.57—1.76 mm, head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 1.06—1.13 mm, head length (to apex of labrum) 1.43—1.56 mm, head width 1.02—1.04 mm, pronotum length 0.29—0.31 mm, width 0.62—0.69 mm.
